query:
UPDATE products
                    SET sku = $2, product_name = $3, category = $4,
                        description = $5, unit_price = $6,
                        unit_cost = $7, firmware_version = $8,
                        lead_time_days = $9, active = $10,
                        version = version + 1
                  WHERE id = $1
                 RETURNING id, version
